content: Official Firebase Firestore documentation describes cached reads while offline and synchronization of local writes after reconnect, with last-write-wins for multiple writes to a document. Since this phase requires offline read-only use, avoid enabling an implicit offline write queue; define a signed-in, per-member read cache, disable editing offline, purge on sign-out, and test cache isolation. Cached data cannot be remotely revoked while a device remains disconnected; owner-removal behavior needs confirmation. Source: firebase.google.com/docs/firestore/manage-data/enable-offline
